INSERT INTO "conversation_tool_dispatch" ( "creator_id", "modifier_id", "round_id", "attempt_id", "turn_number", "tool_call_id", "tool_name", "tool_key", "server_id", "arguments_json", "state", "dispatch_time", "result_time", "trace_id", "span_id", "transport_evidence", "recovery_reason" ) VALUES
(#{item.creatorId}, #{item.modifierId}, #{item.roundId}, #{item.attemptId}, #{item.turnNumber}, #{item.toolCallId}, #{item.toolName}, #{item.toolKey}, #{item.serverId}, CAST(#{item.argumentsJson} AS JSONB), #{item.state}, #{item.dispatchTime}, #{item.resultTime}, #{item.traceId}, #{item.spanId}, #{item.transportEvidence}, #{item.recoveryReason})
ON CONFLICT ("round_id", "attempt_id") DO UPDATE SET "state" = EXCLUDED."state", "dispatch_time" = COALESCE("conversation_tool_dispatch"."dispatch_time", EXCLUDED."dispatch_time"), "result_time" = EXCLUDED."result_time", "transport_evidence" = EXCLUDED."transport_evidence", "recovery_reason" = EXCLUDED."recovery_reason" WHERE "conversation_tool_dispatch"."state" IN ('READY', 'DISPATCHING') AND EXCLUDED."state" <> 'READY'
